testScenarios.detailedSteps:
1. Keyboard in an active position (Position B). 
2. Open Notepad or Wordpad.  
Verify: Normal keypresses are working - All letters and numbers are working. Check they appear in Notepad or Wordpad. 
Verify: Function keys are working. (F1 - F12) 
Verify: All special keys are working (ie Volume, Brightness, etc.). These are located at the top of the keyboard and the FN lock must be turned off to access them. 
Verify: Windows key is working. Pressing it should open the Start menu. 
Verify: Right click key is working. 
Verify: Modifier keys are working. The modifiers are the Shift, Ctrl, and Alt. Open Notepad or Wordpad and type Shift+A for capital A, Ctrl+S to save the document and Alt+F to open the file menu.

1. Keyboard BlueTooth connected to DUT. 
2. DUT connected to internet and test account logged in. 
3. Press Copilot button. 
Verify: Copilot button launches Copliot. 
Note: Download Microsoft Copilot from MS Store if needed. Check Settings -> Personalization -> Text Input -> Customize key on keyyboard to set Copilot as action for Copliot key

1. Press Ctrl+Alt+Del 
Verify: Screen with Task Manger option populates.

1. Press and hold down a QWERTY key. 
Verify: The character repeats when key is held (qqqqqqqqqqqqq)

1. Press spacebar in different locations along the bar. 
Verify: Spacebar reportes correctly wherever the key is pressed.

1. Keyboard in Position B. 
2. Move keyboard to Position A and then back to B. 
Verify: Keypresses working within 3 seconds. Type keys into Notepad or Wordpad app.

1. Keyboard in an Active position (Position B). 
2. Press the Caps Lock key several times. 
Verify: The Caps Lock LED turns on and off.

testScenarios.objective: Caps Lock State maintained during CS
testScenarios.detailedSteps:
1. Keyboard in an Active position (Position B). 
2. Turn on Caps Lock. 
3. Press Power Button to go to CS. 
4. Wait 10 seconds and press Power Button to return to S0. 
5. Type a few characters into Notepad or Wordpad. 
Verify: The letters are capital letters. 
6. Repeat with Caps Lock turned OFF. 
Verify: The letters typed are lower case.

testScenarios.objective: Caps Lock State maintained during Hibernate
testScenarios.detailedSteps:
1. Keyboard in an Active position (Position B). 
2. Turn on Caps Lock. 
3. Hibernate the device, wait 30 seconds. 
4. Press Power Button to return to S0. 
5. Type a few characters into Notepad or Wordpad. 
Verify: The letters are capital letters. 
6. Repeat with Caps Lock turned OFF. 
Verify: The letters typed are lower case.

1. Keyboard in an Active position (Position B). 
2. Press Fn Key several times. 
Verify: The Fn key LED turns on and off.

testScenarios.objective: Fn Lock State maintained during CS.
testScenarios.detailedSteps:
1. Keyboard in an Active position (Position B). 
2. Turn on Fn Lock. 
3. Press Power Button to go to CS. 
4. Wait a few seconds and press Power Button to return to S0. 
5. Press F1. 
Verify: Help window launches. 
6. Repeat steps with Fn Lock turned OFF. 
Verify: Help window does not launch. 
(See Testing Notes to the right when testing SLSE)

testScenarios.objective: Caps Lock and Fn Lock LED
testScenarios.detailedSteps:
1. Turn on Caps Lock and Fn Lock so LED is On. 
2. Move device to inactive position (Position A) 
.Verify: The Caps Lock LED and Fn Lock LED turn off 
.3. Move device back to active position (Position B). 
Verify: The Caps Lock LED and Fn Lock LED both come back On.

testScenarios.objective: Wake From CS with Keypress and Touchpad Swipe
testScenarios.detailedSteps:
1. Press Power Button to enter CS. 
2. Press a Key. 
Verify: The device wakes to S0. 
3. Press Power Button to enter CS. 
4. Swipe the touchpad. 
Verify: The device wakes to S0.

1. Close the keyboard (position A) to enter CS. 
2. Open the keyboard to Position B. 
Verify: The device wakes.

1. Device in Position B. 
2. Set Power Options -> Close Lid -> Do Nothing -> Save Changes. 
3. Close the lid. 
Verify: The device screen turns Off. 
4. Open the lid. 
Verify: The device returns to S0, Screen On. 
5. Press some keys and use touchpad including PTP Gestures (2 finger). 
Verify:  Keys, touchpad (PTP), Backlight, Pen on Touchscreen all working.
